summary: Screens now tell you clearly what they did, so a successful action never looks like a lost one.

new.title: See your update ring in the Manager
new.text: The header shows which update ring the environment is on. Jobs has an Updates & ring panel with the running version, the approved version and the last update run.

fixes.title: Revoke selected reports what it staged
fixes.text: Review standing access now shows how many rows were staged and which were refused, with the reason. Nothing is revoked until you commit.

fixes.title: Your commit shows up in the queue
fixes.text: The change queue now opens with recent commits included. A committed change shows as saved, and the engine applies it on its next run.
